{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Will|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Will''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that gives [[Reach]] I. It is crafted from four [[Stable Void]]s.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/reach.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Will" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Will is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Reach applies to chestplates and adds 2 blocks of block interaction range. Level I is the only level any source gives, although the enchantment goes up to III by combining books in an anvil.

In 1.12.2 the book does not store Reach itself but <code>main:reach</code>, the enchantment's id before the pack moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace. Its tooltip line reads "ERROR: Please wear me to update I".<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/main/enchantment/reach.json}}</ref> The old enchantment applies to chestplates like Reach and does nothing by itself, but each tick a chestplate carrying it is worn, one level of it is replaced with one level of Reach, so the chestplate has Reach as soon as it is put on.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/main/item_modifier/update_reach.json}}</ref> The converted level is added to any Reach the chestplate already has, so applying the prayer to a chestplate with Reach III gives Reach IV, one level above the normal maximum.
